Uttar Pradesh Faces Heavy Rain, Thunderstorms, and Hail

Uttar Pradesh experienced a significant shift in weather on Tuesday, with several districts in the Terai and Purvanchal regions recording a drop in temperature due to thunderstorms, strong winds, and rain. In Lucknow, approximately 40,000 homes were submerged. The forecast indicates potential rain in 8 districts of Bihar and continued adverse weather in parts of Uttarakhand, including Almora and Uttarkashi. The meteorological department has issued alerts for heavy rain, thunderstorms, and hailstorms across Uttar Pradesh for the next three days.
